title: 2522. Partition String Into Substrings With Values at Most K

examples.explanation: We can partition the string into substrings "16", "54", "6", and "2". Each substring has a value less than or equal to k = 60. It can be shown that we cannot partition the string into less than 4 substrings.
There is no good partition for this string.
